points.name: Orokonui Ecosanctuary
points.description: Conservation sanctuary near Dunedin with public visitor information and guided experiences. This marker represents the reserve area, not its entrance or a bird location.

points.name: Abel Tasman Eco Tours
points.description: Nature-tour operator departing from Mārahau. The operator describes support for local conservation projects. This is an approximate departure-area reference, not an office or confirmed meeting point. Check arrangements with the operator.
points.coordinateSource: Mārahau area shown on the operator contact map

points.name: Arrowtown Chinese Settlement
points.description: A publicly interpreted historic settlement, partly restored after archaeological excavation. Follow DOC visitor guidance and stay on public paths.

points.name: Lake Rotoiti · Nelson Lakes
points.description: Forest and lake landscape reference for planning a nature outing. Check DOC for current tracks, access and biosecurity guidance. No sightings are promised.
